entries.name: github-orchestrator:actions-optimizer
entries.intent: Reduce GitHub Actions wall-clock time and cost through cache, job graph, matrix, concurrency, and path-filter changes

entries.name: github-orchestrator:adversarial-verifier
entries.intent: Attempt to refute a review finding and default to refuted when the evidence is not conclusive

entries.name: github-orchestrator:api-contract-reviewer
entries.intent: Detect breaking changes to public interfaces, schemas, and wire formats, and require a migration path for each

entries.name: github-orchestrator:branch-strategist
entries.intent: Choose the correct base branch and name for a change, and keep branches current against a moving base

entries.name: github-orchestrator:build-doctor
entries.intent: Diagnose and repair build, compile, lint, and typecheck failures by root cause rather than by silencing the error

entries.name: github-orchestrator:changelog-scribe
entries.intent: Write changelog entries and release notes describing user-visible effects rather than restating commit subjects

entries.name: github-orchestrator:ci-triage-analyst
entries.intent: Classify each failing CI check as real regression, flaky, infrastructure, base-branch breakage, or config drift before anything is changed

entries.name: github-orchestrator:conflict-resolver
entries.intent: Predict collisions between in-flight pull requests and resolve merge conflicts by reconciling both sides' intent

entries.name: github-orchestrator:correctness-reviewer
entries.intent: Find logic defects in a diff with a concrete failing input for each finding

entries.name: github-orchestrator:dedup-detective
entries.intent: Find duplicate issues by symptom rather than wording, across both open and closed issues

entries.name: github-orchestrator:dependency-steward
entries.intent: Assess dependency freshness and maintenance risk and orchestrate upgrades in risk-ordered batches

entries.name: github-orchestrator:docs-reviewer
entries.intent: Find documentation that this diff made wrong, and undocumented changes users need to know about

entries.name: github-orchestrator:dora-analyst
entries.intent: Compute DORA four keys from repository history and attribute every movement to a specific cause

entries.name: github-orchestrator:epic-decomposer
entries.intent: Break an epic into independently shippable sub-issues ordered by dependency with explicit acceptance criteria

entries.name: github-orchestrator:flake-detective
entries.intent: Confirm test flakiness across runs, diagnose the source of nondeterminism, and quarantine with a tracked issue and owner

entries.name: github-orchestrator:gh-advisor
entries.intent: Analyze all in-flight GitHub state and recommend prioritized next best actions with evidence, without mutating anything

entries.name: github-orchestrator:gh-orchestrator
entries.intent: Coordinate the GitHub delivery teams, decompose a delivery goal into team assignments, and own the end-to-end outcome

entries.name: github-orchestrator:hotspot-scout
entries.intent: Find files where change frequency and defect density combine into elevated risk, and explain why each is fragile

entries.name: github-orchestrator:issue-triager
entries.intent: Classify issues by type and severity, assess reproducibility, size them, and route them to an owner

entries.name: github-orchestrator:merge-marshal
entries.intent: Re-verify every merge policy gate against live state immediately before merging, and refuse the merge when any gate fails

entries.name: github-orchestrator:ownership-mapper
entries.intent: Reconcile declared CODEOWNERS against real authorship to find drift, gaps, and bus-factor risk, and route reviewers

entries.name: github-orchestrator:performance-reviewer
entries.intent: Find performance defects that scale badly with input size, load, or data growth

entries.name: github-orchestrator:pr-author
entries.intent: Write pull request titles and bodies from the actual diff, following repository templates and omitting sensitive content

entries.name: github-orchestrator:release-conductor
entries.intent: Compute the semver bump from conventional commits, verify release readiness gates, and tag and publish

entries.name: github-orchestrator:repo-cartographer
entries.intent: Map repository structure, module boundaries, entry points, and dependency direction to orient other agents quickly

entries.name: github-orchestrator:review-synthesizer
entries.intent: Merge surviving review findings on a blackboard, deduplicate across lenses, rank by severity, and emit one verdict

entries.name: github-orchestrator:rollback-planner
entries.intent: Analyze rollback blast radius and recommend rollback, forward-fix, or a feature-flag flip

entries.name: github-orchestrator:secret-sentinel
entries.intent: Detect committed secrets and drive revoke-first remediation without ever exposing the secret value

entries.name: github-orchestrator:security-reviewer
entries.intent: Find exploitable security defects in a diff with a concrete attack path for each finding

entries.name: github-orchestrator:stack-manager
entries.intent: Build and maintain stacked pull request topologies, splitting oversized branches and rebasing descendants after landings

entries.name: github-orchestrator:supply-chain-auditor
entries.intent: Rank vulnerability alerts by whether the vulnerable code is reachable from an entry point, and verify code-scanning findings

entries.name: github-orchestrator:test-coverage-critic
entries.intent: Find untested behavior and tests that cannot fail, judging test quality rather than coverage percentage
